principle: Financial coverage is complete only when every published relationship in scope is evidence-backed, canonicalized, verified in both supported directions, verified for every published passenger tier, and unpublished or ambiguous requests fail closed.

blockers: Authoritative confirmation is still required for unresolved STT endpoint aliases, including broad Town/Lindbergh Bay/Dorothea identities where the reviewed mapping does not prove equivalence.
Red Hook to/from Dorothea 2+ passenger fare conflict remains unresolved and must not quote through an inferred value.
Full governed direct/reverse and passenger-tier reconciliation must reach zero mismatches.

verificationEvidence.scope: 139-row STJ published inventory, governed Caneel Bay/Westin tiers, route-qualified identities, reviewed Neptune Landing/Windmill alias, deterministic luggage charge, and fail-closed unsupported special charges

stj.nonCoverageProvisions: Oversized-item, waiting-time, round-trip, radio/phone, negotiated exclusivity, and other conditional special-charge provisions remain fail-closed unless the governed quote schema can represent their required conditions deterministically. They cannot manufacture a fare and are not used to claim unsupported special-charge computation.

verificationEvidence.scope: published STX tariff relationships and fail-closed governed matching

stx.nonCoverageProvision: The published unlisted-destination provision remains disabled until governed road-order geography and deterministic tests exist; it is not used to claim published-table coverage and cannot manufacture a fare.

completionRule: complete may become true only when all required islands are complete and every hard failure count is zero. No inferred fare may be used to satisfy coverage.
